Synopsis:
    Two workers were rescued alive from a tunnel at the Upper Trishuli 3A Hydropower Station nine days after a glacier collapse on the Trishuli River triggered a massive ice, rock and mud slide. The disaster killed over 1,200 people and displaced tens of thousands. At least 900 people are believed trapped across tunnels linked to six hydropower projects along the river. One rescued worker has limited mobility; the other's injuries are non-critical. Both are being transported to a Kathmandu hospital.
